Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the children's administration in the department of social and health services to become accredited.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the accreditation of the department of socialand health services children's administration offices; adding a newsection to chapter 74.13 RCW; and repealing RCW 74.13.017.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All field offices and the headquarters office of the children'sadministration in the department shall become accredited by anationally recognized child welfare accrediting entity no later thanDecember 31, 2008. (2) If an unexpected fatality or near fatality of a child receivingcare or services from a particular field office occurs, the departmentshall notify the accrediting entity of this fact. Within six months ofthe occurrence of the fatality or near fatality, the accrediting entityshall review that office to determine whether the office continues tomeet accreditation standards. (3) For purposes of this section, "near fatality" has the samemeaning as that stated in RCW 74.13.500(4).
RCW 74.13.017 (AccreditationCompletiondate) and 2003 c 207 s 8 & 2001 c 265 s 2 are each repealed.
